title: Inventory Aggregator
prompt:
csv_text = "apple,fruit
carrot,veg
banana,fruit
leek,veg
cherry,fruit" is given. Write count_categories(text) that parses the CSV (comma-separated, one item per line) and returns a dict mapping each category (column 2) to how many items it has. Print the dict — one line.

tests.name: categories counted
tests.code:
assert count_categories("a,f\nb,f") == {"f": 2}, "two-line case"
assert count_categories(csv_text) == {"fruit": 3, "veg": 2}, f"main case: {count_categories(csv_text)}"
tests.hint: split lines, split commas, tally column 2 in a dict — or use Counter.
